name: Israel, Gaza & region
summary: Houthis claim six attacks on Saudi oil sites and Riyadh airport on 7 Nov; Houthis say Saudi strikes killed 27
state: Houthi spokesman Yahya Saree said on 7 Nov the group carried out six operations against Aramco facilities, Riyadh airport and Saudi troops; Saudi Arabia had not responded publicly (Middle East Eye). Houthi-run media said Saudi strikes on a village in Sanaa province killed 27 people the same day, a figure not independently confirmed (The New Arab). In Gaza, rain flooded shelters on 7 Nov as aid deliveries stay below agreed levels (Al Jazeera).
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice for Saudi Arabia, Yemen, Israel and Lebanon before travelling; flights in the region can be disrupted at short notice.
